title: Isiah Pacheco: Jahmyr Gibbs is a hell of a player, my job is contribute anywhere I can

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Isiah Pacheco: Jahmyr Gibbs is a hell of a player, my job is contribute anywhere I can
sources.description: Free agent running back Isiah Pacheco signed with the Lions to back up Jahmyr Gibbs, and Pacheco says he's ready to do whatever he can in a backup role.
